definitions.gloss: naturally curly, wavy or frizzy hair
definitions.explanation: Hair that is naturally wavy, curly or unruly rather than straight. In Japan, where straight hair is the norm, it is often treated as something to tame.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧くせ{毛|げ}だ。

examples.english: My frizzy hair puffs out on rainy days.

examples.japanese: くせ{毛|げ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦アイロン→アイロン：05071_airon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}ばしている→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: My hair is very curly, so I straighten it with an iron every morning.

notes:
Also written {癖毛|くせげ}; ⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧ here means "a kink". The more neutral word for naturally wavy hair is ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧⟦パーマ→パーマ：28205_paama⟧, often shortened to {天|てん}パ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- くせ{毛|げ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to tame or straighten curly hair
- くせ{毛|げ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: frizzy hair puffs out
- {縮毛矯正|しゅくもうきょうせい}: chemical hair straightening

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧: straight (hair)
- ⟦パーマ→パーマ：28205_paama⟧: a perm
